description: Address v2 review findings: VLAN-tagged inter-VLAN probes, payment classifier false positives, ACL gap propagation, double-persist guard, and proper CIDR parsing
steps: Fix network_mapper.py _detect_inter_vlan_routing: Add Dot1Q tags to probe packets and document trunk port requirement
Fix network_mapper.py _classify_segment: Require at least one POS-specific port (4100, 9100, 20000) for payment classification
Fix network_mapper.py: Back-propagate _acl_gaps to per-segment dicts after _detect_acl_gaps completes
Fix network_mapper.py: Add _persisted flag to prevent double-persist from map_all() and stop()
Fix net_utils.py parse_cidr: Implement proper CIDR parsing respecting prefix length, clamping /16 and larger to 1024 hosts
acceptance_criteria: network_mapper.py: _detect_inter_vlan_routing sends Dot1Q-tagged probes with source VLAN, docstring documents trunk port requirement
network_mapper.py: payment classification requires at least one POS-specific port (4100, 9100, or 20000)
network_mapper.py: after _detect_acl_gaps, gaps are copied to self._segments[gap dst_vlan][acl_gaps]
network_mapper.py: _persist_results is guarded by self._persisted flag to prevent duplicate rows
net_utils.py: parse_cidr correctly generates hosts for arbitrary prefix lengths (/28=14, /24=254, /16 clamped to 1024)
All modified files pass ast.parse validation
verification: python3 -c "import ast; import glob; files=glob.glob('posframework/**/*.py', recursive=True); [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in files]; print(f'All {len(files)} files parse OK')"
findings: All 5 v2 review issues addressed. parse_cidr now properly handles arbitrary prefix lengths with tests confirming /24=254, /28=14, /16=1024 (clamped), /32=1, /31=2 hosts. Inter-VLAN probes use Ether()/Dot1Q(vlan=src_vlan)/IP()/ICMP() framing. Payment classifier requires at least one of 4100/9100/20000 present. ACL gaps propagated via _propagate_acl_gaps() method. Double-persist prevented by _persisted flag. Bidirectional changed to 0 since we only test one direction per probe. All 67 files pass ast.parse.
